rules: A WP is `ready` only when every `dependsOn` is `done` and every design in `designs` is `received` OR the WP is flagged `designAhead: true`.
Two WPs may be `in-progress` simultaneously only if their `files` globs do not overlap (enforced by `pnpm codegraph:check`).
Every WP must add or extend tests listed in `tests` BEFORE its status can move to `review`; tests must include at least one negative/adversarial case per acceptance bullet.
Every SCR WP must add a screen-contract e2e spec (tests/e2e/screens/<ID>.spec.ts) generated by `pnpm screen:scaffold <ID>` with every SPEC state implemented (no `test.fixme` left).
Every WP that changes a contract must update the mock AND real service and the parity test.
Status moves to `done` only after a skeptic review (see 04-AGENT-PLAYBOOK.md §5) with zero P0/P1 findings and `pnpm codegraph:check` green.

acceptance: SH-01 has usable Forgot password and Open your invite link actions and matches Packet A across supported viewport/theme variants
Valid same-origin invite links open directly or through paste, and invalid/off-origin links are rejected
Keep me signed in sets a 30-day session and survives MFA; unchecked login remains a browser-session cookie
Production auth emails use configured canonical HTTPS links and the configured Resend sender fields

Reset requests stay enumeration-safe and never return a production token

packages.agentNotes: 2026-09-26: priority implementation pushed in commit f53db1e. Focused auth lint passed; user-admin/rate-limit unit tests 20/20 and auth-link unit tests 3/3 passed. Added per-login 30-day persistence with MFA propagation and same-origin invite URL enforcement. At user direction, remaining verification was waived and package moved to review to unblock the queue. Risk: DB-backed email/session assertions, Chromium (including mobile/dark), Lighthouse, and skeptic review are unverified; production email requires BULWARK_APP_URL plus an active organization Resend provider. Pushed branch does not itself deploy production. 2026-09-26 (claude-code skeptic review): two P1s found and fixed. (1) Keep me signed in was lost: login re-sealed the session via setActiveOrgOverride without maxAge, downgrading the 30-day cookie to a browser-session cookie; the adapter now stores persistentSeconds in the session and re-applies it on every write, and a fresh authentication starts a clean session. (2) Reset links were replayable for their full hour: tokens now carry a password-hash fingerprint and redeem with compare-and-set, so a link dies after use or after any later password change. Also fixed tests that had never run against the SH-01 redesign (wrapper testid, ambiguous Password label, mock-shaped invite tokens on the real backend) — invite pasted-link and accept-invite now run end to end against the real backend via user.invite. Verified: auth.real integration 15/15 (replay + stale-link negatives), e2e auth + auth-recovery pass on the built server (dev-only quick-pick/reset-link tests skip there via isBuiltServer()). Found during review, filed to WP-L07: user.invite has no role check (any member can mint org_admin invites). SH-01 screen contract (tests/e2e/screens/SH-01.spec.ts, non-fixme checks) 7/7 on the built server: runtime-clean at 1440/390, dark tokens, axe light+dark, touch targets >=48px at 390 (fixed: links, Show toggle, brand lockup, skip link, 24px checkbox glyph in a 48px row), public route. Heading aligned to the design (display face, 700, 26px). Visual side-by-side with the SH-01 baseline matches apart from tenant name/sample data. The per-state/action fixmes in SH-01.spec.ts (MFA, backup code, lockout, offline) are WP-S1 scope.

packages.agentNotes: 2026-09-26: started after WP-SH01. Slice 1 adds migration 0017/message_deliveries with HMAC recipient hashes, provider statuses, event/entity context, and per-attempt rows. Email/SMS adapters now throw for transactional production failures and return explicit fan-out failures; notification subscriber audits outcomes, increments the comms failure metric, and emits a non-recursive comms.delivery_failed event. SMS fan-out no longer sends the user's email address to Twilio; it records missing phone as failed. Local localhost:5432/bulwark_dev migration applied; focused integration tests pass 3/3 and fan-out unit tests pass 4/4; lint and drizzle-kit check pass. Resend/Twilio calls moved into typed clients (server/services/comms/*-client.ts) with pinned endpoints, 10s timeouts and bounded retries (Resend: 429/5xx/network with Idempotency-Key; Twilio: 429/503 only, never a possibly-sent 500/lost response); attempt counts land in the ledger. Also fixed a live bug: notification-subscriber email/SMS sinks referenced an undefined eventType (ReferenceError on every fan-out send; caught by typecheck).
